title: Candidate-line inventory from source for labeling
description:
Build the candidate-line inventory that labeling batches work from. It comes from the source, not from scanner output, so labels do not inherit scanner behavior.

## Behavior

- Input: repo key, concept (`email`), and the scope file list.
- Output: `tests/benchmark/repos/<repo>/annotations/packets/<concept>-candidates.yaml`, one entry per line: file, line, the line text.
- A line is a candidate when an identifier, property key, string, or comment on it contains `email`, `e_mail`, `mail_to`, `mailto`, `recipient`, `sender`, or `from_address` in any case or separator style. The token list lives in a config file so other concepts reuse the script.
- Deterministic and rerunnable at the pinned commit.

## Done when

Running it on `ghost` and `saleor` scopes produces candidate files, and a spot check of three files finds no email-related line missing.

comments.text: Implemented by a Haiku agent on branch kdatap-1d6b44-candidate-inventory (e0a591e, 0cd82db, cac7c7e, d8b7a6a; based on origin/develop, not pushed). Module tests/benchmark/candidate-inventory.ts with subword matching (split on punctuation and camelCase/acronym boundaries; token parts as consecutive subwords, plural s/es, glued multi-part forms). CLI: pnpm run benchmark:candidates <repo> <concept>. Tokens in tests/benchmark/scripts/candidate-tokens.yaml. Review: two earlier rounds had copied-logic tests and a snake_case regression, both fixed. Independent check: saleor 16/16 grep lines; 25 sampled ghost production files 0 missed, 1 extra (a comment containing 'from address'); no whole files skipped. Ghost whole-scope: 18,605 lines in 901 files (12,948 test/snapshot, 5,657 non-test). Saleor manifest scope is one file (saleor/account/models.py, 16 lines), too narrow for KDATAP-25ff9a. Candidate files are not committed; scoped files get committed with accepted scopes.
